{{Quote|Drowning my sorrows in a pint of nectoral syrup.|An Ithorian|<ref name="MOAI" />}}
'''Nectoral syrup''' was a dark-[[Color/Legends|colored]] beverage enjoyed by some [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]], particularly as a way of easing emotional pain. It could be [[Diet/Legends|consumed]] with a straw and was usually served in an individual [[Glass/Legends|glass]]. An [[Unidentified Ithorian (Rimbaux Four)|Ithorian]] once drowned his sorrows in a [[pint]] of nectoral syrup.<ref name="MOAI" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nectoral syrup was first mentioned and pictured in "Musings of an Ithorian," a segment written by [[Bob Carrau]] for the [[1993]] book ''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]'', a publication that combines creature designs and photographs from various projects of [[George Lucas]], creator of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise, with original text by Carrau.<ref name="MAGL">''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]''</ref> [[Lucasfilm]] employee [[Leland Chee]], who maintains the [[Holocron continuity database]], has indicated that information contained in the book is [[Canon|non-canonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Chee">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=690#14724917|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-05-03|time=5:45 PM|quote=And is information from Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas canon? Unless referred to by a source that is in-continuity, the information is non-continuity.}}</ref>

In [[2007]], the drink was made canonical with the publishing of ''[[Musings of an Ithorian]]'', a reprint of the 1993 article, on [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]], a fan club which offered exclusive content to subscribers until it was discontinued.<ref name="MOAI" />
